title: 第2章 你的电话最好别挂
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“开手术室。”

周明远四个字砸下来，CT室门口的人全都动了。

赵护士一把推开走廊边的平车，冲着抢救室那头喊：“主动脉夹层，准备转运！监护别拔，氧气带上！”

陈建国的妻子还扶着墙，眼睛直直看着林野：“医生，我老公是不是要死了？”

林野看了一眼视野里的倒计时。

23分46秒。

他没有把话说死，只把声音压稳：“现在发现了，就还有机会。要马上手术，您跟着去签字，别耽误。”

女人点头，腿软得差点跪下去，被赵护士伸手拽住。

孙志强站在操作间门口，脸色青一阵白一阵。主动脉CTA影像摆在屏幕上，那条撕开的内膜片像一根细线，明晃晃地戳在他眼前。

刚才他说的“急性胃炎、胰腺炎都常见”，现在一句也接不上。

但接不上，不代表没事。

他转头盯住林野：“你把申请单、病程记录都补全。”

“我现在跟病人去手术室。”

“你先写清楚。”孙志强声音压得很低，“规培生林野坚持申请急诊主动脉CTA，坚持越级联系心脏大血管外科主任。这个流程是你推的，申请依据和签名都要留清楚。”

林野手指攥着病历夹，纸边把掌心硌出一道印。

他知道这句话是什么意思。

病人活了，是判断敏锐。病人死了，申请单上第一个名字就是他。

倒计时还在跳。

22分31秒。

林野拿起笔，在病程记录上写下时间、症状、双上肢血压差、背部撕裂样疼痛、CTA所见。每一笔都写得很快，写到“联系心脏大血管外科周明远主任”时，笔尖顿了一下，又继续往下落。

赵护士推着陈建国从CT室出来。

陈建国已经疼得说不出完整的话，嘴唇发紫，监护仪上的心率一路往上跳。女人跟在平车旁边，手按着签字板，指头抖得签不成名字。

“签这里。”巡回护士把笔塞给她，“手术风险已经告知，夹层随时可能破裂。”

女人看着那几行字，眼泪啪地砸在纸上：“我不懂，我真的不懂。医生，你们救他，我签，我都签。”

林野把签字板扶住。

“写陈建国妻子，李桂兰。”

女人照着写，最后一个字还没写完，电梯门开了。

周明远从里面大步走出来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Open the operating room."

The words Zhou Mingyuan were smashed down, and everyone at the door of the CT room moved.

Nurse Zhao pushed the flatbed cart away from the corridor and shouted towards the other side of the emergency room: "Aortic dissection, prepare for transfer! Keep me under control, put oxygen on!"

Chen Jianguo's wife was still holding on to the wall, looking straight at Lin Ye: "Doctor, is my husband going to die?"

Lin Ye glanced at the countdown in his field of vision.

23 minutes and 46 seconds.

He didn't say anything, he just kept his voice steady: "Now that we have discovered it, we still have a chance. We need to have surgery immediately. Please go and sign. Don't delay."

The woman nodded, her legs were so weak that she almost knelt down, but Nurse Zhao stretched out her hand to grab her.

Sun Zhiqiang stood at the door of the operation room, his face turning blue and white.The aortic CTA image was displayed on the screen, and the torn intima was like a thin line, dazzling in front of his eyes.

He just said "acute gastritis and pancreatitis are common", but now he can't finish a sentence.

But if you can't connect, it doesn't mean it's okay.

He turned and stared at Lin Ye: "Please complete the application form and disease history record."

"I'm going to the operating room with the patient now."

"You write clearly first." Sun Zhiqiang's voice was very low. "Guipei student Lin Ye insisted on applying for emergency aortic CTA and insisted on contacting the director of cardiac and macrovascular surgery at a higher level. This process was initiated by you. The application basis and signature must be clearly stated."

Lin Ye held the medical record folder with his fingers, and the edge of the paper made a mark on his palm.

He knew what it meant.

The patient is alive because of his keen judgment.When the patient dies, he is the first name on the application form.

The countdown is still ticking.

22 minutes and 31 seconds.

Lin Ye picked up a pen and wrote down the time, symptoms, blood pressure difference in both upper limbs, tearing pain in the back, and CTA findings on the disease course record.Each stroke was written very quickly. When he wrote "Contact Director Zhou Mingyuan of Cardiac and Vascular Surgery", the pen tip paused and continued to fall.

Nurse Zhao pushed Chen Jianguo out of the CT room.

Chen Jianguo was in so much pain that he couldn't speak complete sentences, his lips were purple, and his heart rate on the monitor was jumping all the way up.The woman followed the flat car, pressing the signature board with her hand, her fingers shaking so hard that she couldn't sign her name.

"Sign here." The circulating nurse gave her the pen. "The risks of the operation have been informed. The dissection may rupture at any time."

The woman looked at the few lines of words and burst into tears on the paper: "I don't understand, I really don't understand. Doctor, you save him, I'll sign, I'll sign everything."

Lin Ye held the signature board.

"Write about Chen Jianguo's wife, Li Guilan."

The woman continued to write, but before she finished writing the last word, the elevator door opened.

Zhou Mingyuan strode out from inside.
